Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]] between the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' and three [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].

==Battle==
While patrolling the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' encountered three [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. In the ensuing battle, the Imperial vessel was victorious, capturing several pirates including their leader, [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]]. However, the ''Relentless'' suffered severe damage to its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="TM" />

Interrogating Quist, the pirate revealed information that [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], long thought dead, was in fact alive and in hiding. With the information about Tallon's survival, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ranif Parlan]] issued [[Imperial Bounty 82,471|Imperial Bounty #82,471]] for his capture. This bounty led to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] being flooded by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to [[Escape from Tatooine|hunt]] for him.<ref name="TM" />
